notes.title: Haywire on Fuel Station Zeta Released!
notes.content:
Mad Goblin Games is proud to announce the release of Haywire on Fuel Station Zeta.

I would like to sincerely thank everyone for all the support they have given to make this game a reality. It has been a long road and I am so proud to have the chance to share it.
